items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Wilson had just started up his band and he had a trumpet player named Carl George.

ctx.x: was not the right word to use for them, because what they were doing wasn't theory, they made it reality, you know. They were doing it, it wasn't theory. They turned it into the real thing.

And it seemed like at that time, '39 and the '40s, everybody's pretty excited about jazz. They all liked to talk about it, Teddy Wilson had just started up his band and he had a trumpet player named Carl George.
Yeah, I remember, excellent trumpet player.
